text.p: Arthur J Gallagher & Co said Thursday that it has decided a major restructuring is "unnecessary and unwarranted."
The company issued the statement after completing what it said was a restructuring review and cost containment analysis for the fourth quarter.

In October the insurance brokerage and risk management services firm said that it was considering taking a one-time restructuring charge and that it did not expect fourth quarter results to attain the levels of the 1995 fourth quarter.
The company said that although it is no longer considering a restructuring charge, its outlook for the fourth quarter doesn't change.
"We still do not expect to make the fourth quarter," Executive Vice President Michael Cloherty said.
